decisions.statement: A way in names a file the change leaves behind that change.
Every manifest the index names is judged whether or not the change has that manifest.
This check catches a file moving away from under a way in.
A refusal is filed at the manifest rather than at the file that moved.
A refusal names the specifier as well as the path.
Which ways in a manifest names is read by `package-manifest`.
A manifest that will not parse names no way in.
A manifest calling its package nothing names no way in.
A key that is not a lone dot and does not open with a dot names no way in.
Whether the file a way in lands on can be parsed is not judged here.
A target nested under a condition is no way in this check judges.
A file named by `main` or `bin` is no way in this check judges.
A way in landing on a path spelling a `*` is no way in this check judges.

definition: the check refusing a way into a package that lands where no file is
